status: Proposal only; all numeric appearance values are authored assumptions unless identified as repository constraints.

units.hex: sRGB light chromaticity or display sky target as identified; decode to linear for math.
units.lightIntensity: Erel: diffuse irradiance relative to calibrated neutral noon key E0=1; not a renderer slider, lux, lumen, candela or watt.
units.emission: Lrel: emitted radiance relative to a unit-albedo Lambertian surface under E0; separate from Erel.
units.colorNormalization: For lighting/emission use linear(hex)/Y(linear(hex)) × Erel or Lrel. Preserve HDR channels; normalize light color before applying scalar.
units.sky: Hex sky stops are output sRGB display targets, exposure-compensated through each adapter; never grade a target hex twice.
units.screen: Halo radii in CSS logical pixels at 390 px phone width; convert with actual drawableWidth/CSSWidth. World geometry stays metres.
units.time: Local civil time with IANA zone; sun and Moon angles from engine models, not local clock presets.

compatibility.moon: If adopted, this pack replaces live-world-v1's optional <=0.08 noon moon ambient scalar with the bounded values here; never add both or weather moon fill.
compatibility.wetness: Reuse rain-v1 per-surface darkening (max 12%); never stack ground/weather/rain reductions.
compatibility.stars: Reuse live-world catalogue, projection, magnitude, 2000-point ceiling and 4000-triangle ceiling. Chicago and Denver profiles are appearance presets, not measured sky surveys.
compatibility.actualLights: Global cap 2 real nearby unshadowed local lights, shared by streetlights/porches/vehicles. Emissive windows are not real lights.
compatibility.scope: Only appearance. No observed household activity implied; recap solar/weather data do not establish historic lamps/window states.

transition.interpolation: Clamp endpoints; smoothstep between adjacent solar elevations; all RGB interpolation in linear space. Blue-hour label is artistic, twilight boundaries are not new ephemeris.
transition.recap: Evaluate directly from replay time/solar angle; omit wall-clock temporal filters after scrubbing. Smooth analytic schedules, preserve deterministic seeds.
transition.directionalShadowOwner: Sun when sun elevation > -3 degrees; Moon only once sun <= -6 and valid moon above horizon; fade through gap and reuse same shadow map, never render both.

sky.gradient: For sky elevation a: w=exp(-max(0,a)/12deg); linearRGB=lerp(zenith,horizon,w). City glow separately uses same sky evaluation.
sky.cityGlow: Direction from data, not always west. wGlow=strength*exp(-0.5*(wrappedAzimuthDelta/halfWidth)^2)*exp(-max(0,elevation)/glowElevationWidth); mix toward profile horizon only once. If direction unknown use a weak isotropic .25-strength horizon term and label fallback.
sky.clouds: Cloud masks occlude stars/Moon. Overcast uses muted cloudy sky; city cloud undersides may brighten near urban glow as authored bounded variation, not extra global exposure.

windows.shareMeaning: Probability of house having >=1 lit room and conditional lit-room probability; not all facade windows. Group openings per room; at least one supported room selected for a lit house. Small scenes need not equal exact percentages.
windows.status: Clearly simulated decorative lighting, not occupancy data.
windows.stableSelection: Stable object/room salts. Fixed threshold ranks produce nested evening-to-late selections; no frame/time-step random sampling. Within +/-0.01 threshold use smoothstep fade. Interpolate local schedule over clock intervals; integrate with indoorNightProminence.
windows.CCTNote: Artistic labels; hex is not a calibrated Planckian spectrum.
windows.curtainPattern: Broad 2–4 fold bands, max +/-8% emission, same window plane/material. Closed lit curtains remain faintly warm; closed does not mean room off.
windows.geometry: Use existing facade openings; no new room meshes or silhouette-changing windows. No occupants. Cull unresolved emissive windows rather than inflate size.

windowSpill.method: Local façade/entry shading mask only for supported opening; never force light through walls.

streetlights.typeSelection: Supplied lamp type wins. Unknown lamp uses warm-white generic profile with inferred flag; neither city is forced to all-sodium or all-LED.
streetlights.heightStatus: Demo assumption, actual mapped geometry wins.
streetlights.spacingStatus: Layout study only; do not generate/move mapped lamps.
streetlights.poolAxis: major axis along road at supplied ground footprint
streetlights.poolFormula: r2=(u/5)^2+(v/2.8)^2; K=max(0,1-r2)^2; add owningLampErel*K to exposed eligible ground shading once.
streetlights.edgeTreatment: Soft falloff; no decal edge or universal road light. Use same field across sidewalk/road normals/materials.

treeUnderlight.method: 2 nearby actual lights supply normal-facing lower crown/trunk shading; distant analytic approximations only on eligible preselected exposed faces.
treeUnderlight.avoid: No whole-tree emission, sky-facing crown rim or foliage color replacement.

halo.kernel: Energy-normalized existing bloom; interpolate radius by projected source size and range; hidden/off lights have zero halo.
halo.sourceCore: True projected luminaire shape; unresolved active lamp may use energy-preserving point without enlarging its physical housing.

streetlights.placement: Use known poles first; generic inferred demo lights carry provenance. Analytic pools clipped to exposed road/sidewalk receiver and parcel/occlusion visibility, not through buildings.
streetlights.receiverOwnership: Each receiver contribution uses either the 2 actual local lights or analytic proxy for that owner, never both. Share/source-clamp energy before final receiver shading.

moon.energyClaim: Stylized calibrated night readability; not physical moon/noon ratio or a lux claim.

shadow.direction: Opposite actual Moon azimuth on ground; length=height*cot(moonElevation).
shadow.policy: Single existing directional shadow map replaces Sun ownership. Clamp/fade distant/very long shadows, not fake a high moon. Moonless/below-horizon/overcast: no lunar shadow.

moon.moonless: No moon direct or moon ambient increment; baseline sky/artificial fill remains, no invented moon disk.
moon.cloudy: Occlude actual disk and attenuate lunar lighting consistently; no starfield over overcast rain.

rain.formula: rain-v1 field * wetness * (1-snowCover) * clamp(owningSourceLrel/referenceSourceLrel,0,1) * receiverEligibility; coefficient<=.24. Reference lamp Lrel=.8; window Lrel=.075. Disabled/unsupported source => zero.
rain.windowReflection: At most 2 of the 6 shared fields; eligible within 6 m of actual lit opening, dim .4× lamp-field coefficient. Skip unsupported geometry/reflection direction.

snow.reflectionSuppression: Wet field multiplied by exposed non-snow fraction. Clear wet strips may reflect, snow does not.
snow.coverage: History-driven independent snow channel; plowed/trodden needs supplied history or explicit demo flag.
snow.sky: Bright blue-white material under cool sky, local warm lamp pools; no bright exposure/ambient and snow-emission stacking.

performance.allocation: Every effect replaces/reuses existing allocation; no new allowance. Pools and wet fields are integrated into existing ground/material variant, no pass per lamp.
performance.haloPolicy: Shared bloom; absent bloom => emissive core only, not additive sprites per lamp.
degradeOrder: disable ripples and inferred window reflection fields
reduce analytic pool/streak count and remove unresolved halos
disable aerial blur before grade readability
reduce rain/snow particle count per rain-v1
reduce distant tree detail/sky points within existing LOD
performance.validation: Actual iPhone 13-class iOS26+; fixed drawable size; 10-minute street and aerial sequences at dusk/night, wet/snow; report worst GPU, p95, thermal and frame stalls. Artwork/desktop browser is not a budget pass.

sources.claim: Civil/nautical/astronomical twilight boundaries at solar center -6/-12/-18 degrees.
v2 §8.1 budgets and rain/live layer caps read on disk.
All house/room/porch shares, lamp spectra labels, regional glow, intensity, halo, shadow-strength and performance subtargets are authored appearance proposals.
